page.layout: One page of running text, with a centred two-line verse quotation in italic below it. Running head at the top. Gathering signature at the lower right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: à pelle fœtida, manus meas abstinuissem: Nemo sanæ mentis camarinam[?] monet, aut fimum stabuli Augiæ verfat, quibus theses tuæ accommodè conferri possunt. Nam, vt ingenuè fatear, ego in hoc stercore ne gemmuam vllam offendi; nihil sanè in illis comperi præter ineptissimas tricas, & insulsissimas nugas, quas ego responso nunquam dignatus fuissem, nisi opellam tuam inimicis meis commodasses ad doctrinam meam oppugnandam. Sed tempus est classicum canere, & pedem conferre; neque grandia tua verba, quibus in ipso limine polliceris, te hanc quæstionem à nullo penitus pertractatam operosè discussurum, me à congressu deterrebunt: Nam norunt omnes Hora-tianum i'lud,

p.i:
Quid tanto dignum feret hic promissor hiatu?
Parturient montes, nascetur ridiculus mus.

page.notes: The running head letters NEVTERICVM are hard to read and may be misread; the word after "camarinam" is uncertain. The verse is set in italic and printed as a centred quotation. The ¶ 3 mark is a gathering signature, not a page number. The page has no printed page number at head or foot. The Google watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
